selection_data: VALIDATION manifest only (279 tasks); TEST is evaluated once, on the selected checkpoint, after training
policy_mode_used_for_selection: stochastic (the PPO policy being trained; validation eval seed 0). Deterministic results are reported but not used
candidates: every evaluated checkpoint: step 0, 10,240, 25,088, 50,176, 75,264, 99,840 decisions (or the last one reached at the wall-clock cap)
rule_in_order: 1. maximise mean(validation success at k=7, validation success at k=10)
2. tie: higher mean construction efficiency (required edges / total ADDs on successful episodes), averaged over k=7 and k=10
3. tie: lower mean road churn (REMOVEs + house-edge replacements per episode), averaged over k=7 and k=10
note: if no checkpoint improves on step 0 the rule can select step 0; that outcome will be reported as 'no learning', not hidden
